program.name: Body Shot Boxing
program.subject: Boxing
program.blurb: Body shots and head shots in bouts, then punch Tabatas and core work.
program.about: Boxing that goes to the body. One day is bouts of body hooks, body-head doubles and level changes; the other is Tabatas of fast punches, then core straight sets, since body shots are taken as much as thrown. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations and harder moves.
program.split: Body & head bouts / punch Tabatas & core
